milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the smoker and be facing toward it to demonstrate they have located it. The smoker is at spawn-relative [5, 1, 7] inside a small oak hut. max_distance=5 ensures the player has entered or is at the entrance of the building. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the smoker, not just passing by. The player starts ~8.7 blocks away so this is not trivially satisfied at spawn.
